meta.sector: Energy (Electricity + Gas) - Essential Entity - NIS2 Annex I
meta.profile: Improved and structured pack with legal/core controls + sector best practices + advanced maturity items

notes.ro: Acest pachet combina cerinte NIS2 de baza cu bune practici sectoriale pentru operatori de energie si gaze. Campul control_type diferentiaza intre mandatory_nis2, sector_best_practice si advanced_maturity.
notes.en: This pack combines core NIS2 requirements with sector-specific practices for electricity and gas operators. The control_type field differentiates between mandatory_nis2, sector_best_practice and advanced_maturity.

text.ro: Entitatea a documentat formal incadrarea ca entitate esentiala in sectorul energie/gaze?
text.en: Has the entity formally documented its qualification as an essential entity in the energy/gas sector?

recommendation.ro: Documentati formal incadrarea, serviciile esentiale si baza legala aplicabila.
recommendation.en: Formally document qualification, essential services and applicable legal basis.

text.ro: Exista un registru al serviciilor esentiale, proceselor critice si sistemelor suport IT/OT?
text.en: Is there a register of essential services, critical processes and supporting IT/OT systems?

recommendation.ro: Creati un registru al serviciilor esentiale si mapati sistemele, datele si dependintele asociate.
recommendation.en: Create a register of essential services and map associated systems, data and dependencies.

text.ro: Exista owner desemnat pentru relatia cu autoritatea competenta, CSIRT si alte autoritati sectoriale?
text.en: Is there a designated owner for relations with the competent authority, CSIRT and other sectoral authorities?

recommendation.ro: Desemnati owner formal si backup pentru relatia cu autoritatile si actualizati datele de contact.
recommendation.en: Appoint a formal owner and backup for authority relations and maintain up-to-date contact details.

text.ro: Exista proceduri documentate pentru notificarea initiala, intermediate si finala a incidentelor conform termenelor aplicabile?
text.en: Are there documented procedures for initial, intermediate and final incident notifications within applicable deadlines?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati procedura de notificare NIS2 cu timpi, roluri, sabloane si criterii de escaladare.
recommendation.en: Formalize the NIS2 notification procedure with timelines, roles, templates and escalation criteria.

text.ro: Exista registru al obligatiilor legale si de raportare pentru NIS2, energie si gaze?
text.en: Is there a register of legal and reporting obligations for NIS2, electricity and gas requirements?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti un registru legal unic pentru obligatii NIS2 si sectoriale, cu owner si frecventa de revizuire.
recommendation.en: Maintain a single legal register for NIS2 and sector obligations, with owners and review frequency.

text.ro: Sunt documentate criteriile de severitate si pragurile de impact pentru incidente cu afectare a serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Are severity criteria and impact thresholds documented for incidents affecting essential services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti praguri de impact pentru indisponibilitate, siguranta, impact operational si furnizare energie/gaze.
recommendation.en: Define impact thresholds for availability, safety, operational impact and energy/gas delivery.

text.ro: Exista evidenta punctelor unice de esec si a dependentelor externe pentru serviciile esentiale?
text.en: Is there an inventory of single points of failure and external dependencies for essential services?

recommendation.ro: Identificati SPOF-urile si dependintele externe si includeti-le in planurile de tratare a riscului si continuitate.
recommendation.en: Identify SPOFs and external dependencies and include them in risk treatment and continuity plans.

text.ro: Exista mecanism de revizuire periodica a schimbarilor legislative si de transpunere nationala relevante pentru NIS2?
text.en: Is there a mechanism for periodic review of legislative changes and national transposition relevant to NIS2?

recommendation.ro: Stabiliti un proces de horizon scanning legal si actualizati controalele si procedurile in functie de modificari.
recommendation.en: Establish a legal horizon-scanning process and update controls and procedures based on changes.

text.ro: Exista evidenta contractelor si acordurilor care pot influenta raportarea incidentelor sau continuitatea serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Is there an inventory of contracts and agreements that may affect incident reporting or essential-service continuity?

recommendation.ro: Centralizati obligatiile contractuale critice privind notificarea, SLA-urile si continuitatea.
recommendation.en: Centralize critical contractual obligations for notification, SLAs and continuity.

text.ro: Exista dovada ca managementul revizuieste periodic conformitatea NIS2 si stadiul masurilor corective?
text.en: Is there evidence that management periodically reviews NIS2 compliance and remediation status?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti o revizuire trimestriala de management a conformitatii NIS2 si a planului de remediere.
recommendation.en: Introduce a quarterly management review of NIS2 compliance and remediation plans.

text.ro: Conducerea este implicata in supravegherea riscurilor cibernetice?
text.en: Is management involved in cyber risk oversight?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati implicarea board-ului si raportarea lunara privind riscurile cibernetice.
recommendation.en: Formalize board involvement and monthly cyber risk reporting.

text.ro: Exista politici si proceduri aprobate de management pentru masurile Art. 21?
text.en: Are management-approved policies and procedures in place for Article 21 measures?

recommendation.ro: Aprobati si mentineti un set complet de politici si proceduri pentru masurile Art. 21.
recommendation.en: Approve and maintain a complete set of policies and procedures for Article 21 measures.

text.ro: Rolurile si responsabilitatile sunt clar definite inclusiv pentru mediul OT?
text.en: Are roles and responsibilities clearly defined including for the OT environment?

recommendation.ro: Definiti roluri si responsabilitati distincte pentru IT, OT, securitate, operatiuni si legal.
recommendation.en: Define distinct roles and responsibilities for IT, OT, security, operations and legal.

text.ro: Managementul primeste training specific NIS2 si scenarii relevante pentru energie/gaze?
text.en: Does management receive NIS2-specific training and scenarios relevant to energy/gas?

recommendation.ro: Planificati sesiuni anuale de training pentru conducere pe scenarii de blackout, sabotaj si incident reporting.
recommendation.en: Plan annual management training sessions on blackout, sabotage and incident-reporting scenarios.

text.ro: Exista un responsabil dedicat pentru securitatea OT / ICS?
text.en: Is there a dedicated owner for OT / ICS security?

recommendation.ro: Numiti un responsabil dedicat pentru OT security, cu mandat, buget si interfata clara cu IT security.
recommendation.en: Appoint a dedicated OT security owner with mandate, budget and a clear interface with IT security.

text.ro: Exista indicatori de performanta si risc (KPI/KRI) pentru securitate cibernetica revizuiti de management?
text.en: Are cyber security KPI/KRI metrics reviewed by management?

recommendation.ro: Definiti KPI/KRI pentru detectie, raspuns, patching, continuitate si third-party risk si raportati-i periodic.
recommendation.en: Define KPI/KRI for detection, response, patching, continuity and third-party risk and report them regularly.

text.ro: Exista un buget anual dedicat pentru securitatea IT si OT aliniat riscurilor?
text.en: Is there a dedicated annual budget for IT and OT security aligned with risks?

recommendation.ro: Aprobati un buget anual dedicat pentru securitatea IT/OT bazat pe riscuri si servicii esentiale.
recommendation.en: Approve a dedicated annual IT/OT security budget based on risks and essential services.

text.ro: Exista un proces de exceptii de risc aprobat formal de management?
text.en: Is there a formal management-approved risk exception process?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal de exceptii, cu owner, termen de expirare si plan de reducere a riscului.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal exception process with owner, expiry date and risk-reduction plan.

text.ro: Exista evaluari independente periodice ale programului NIS2?
text.en: Are there periodic independent assessments of the NIS2 program?

recommendation.ro: Programati evaluari interne si/sau externe independente ale programului NIS2 si urmariti remedierea gap-urilor.
recommendation.en: Schedule independent internal and/or external assessments of the NIS2 program and track remediation.

text.ro: Exista o revizuire anuala a cadrului de guvernanta cyber pentru energia si gazele furnizate?
text.en: Is there an annual review of the cyber governance framework for delivered electricity and gas services?

recommendation.ro: Revizuiti anual cadrul de guvernanta cyber si aliniati-l la schimbari tehnologice, operationale si legale.
recommendation.en: Review the cyber governance framework annually and align it to technology, operations and legal changes.

text.ro: Exista un proces formal de evaluare si tratare a riscurilor cibernetice?
text.en: Is there a formal process for cyber risk assessment and treatment?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal si repetabil pentru identificarea, evaluarea, tratarea si monitorizarea riscurilor cyber.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal and repeatable process for identifying, assessing, treating and monitoring cyber risks.

text.ro: Riscurile sunt prioritizate pe baza impactului asupra serviciilor esentiale de electricitate si gaze?
text.en: Are risks prioritized based on impact on essential electricity and gas services?

recommendation.ro: Prioritizati riscurile in functie de impactul asupra serviciilor esentiale, sigurantei si continuitatii operationale.
recommendation.en: Prioritize risks based on impact to essential services, safety and operational continuity.

text.ro: Registrul de riscuri include dependente IT, OT, telecom si furnizori externi?
text.en: Does the risk register include IT, OT, telecom and external supplier dependencies?

recommendation.ro: Extindeti registrul de riscuri pentru a include toate dependintele tehnologice si operationale relevante.
recommendation.en: Extend the risk register to include all relevant technology and operational dependencies.

text.ro: Schimbarile majore SCADA/PLC/HMI sunt supuse evaluarii de risc inainte de implementare?
text.en: Are major SCADA/PLC/HMI changes subject to risk assessment before implementation?

recommendation.ro: Faceti obligatorie evaluarea de risc pre-change pentru toate modificarile majore din mediul OT.
recommendation.en: Make pre-change risk assessment mandatory for all major changes in the OT environment.

text.ro: Sunt evaluate scenariile de impact in cascada asupra retelei si operatiunilor?
text.en: Are cascading-impact scenarios on the grid and operations assessed?

recommendation.ro: Modelati scenarii de propagare a impactului si integrati rezultatele in continuitate si raspuns la incidente.
recommendation.en: Model cascading impact scenarios and integrate results into continuity and incident response.

text.ro: Riscurile asociate echipamentelor OT legacy fara patch-uri disponibile sunt evaluate formal?
text.en: Are risks related to legacy OT equipment without available patches formally assessed?

recommendation.ro: Inventariati echipamentele legacy si definiti controale compensatorii si un plan de inlocuire prioritizat.
recommendation.en: Inventory legacy equipment and define compensating controls and a prioritized replacement plan.

text.ro: Riscurile fizice si de sabotaj sunt integrate in acelasi model de risc cu riscurile cyber?
text.en: Are physical and sabotage risks integrated into the same risk model as cyber risks?

recommendation.ro: Adoptati o abordare all-hazards care sa combine riscurile cyber, fizice, de mediu si operationale.
recommendation.en: Adopt an all-hazards approach combining cyber, physical, environmental and operational risks.

text.ro: Riscurile reziduale sunt acceptate formal la nivel adecvat de management?
text.en: Are residual risks formally accepted at the appropriate management level?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati acceptarea riscurilor reziduale, inclusiv justificarea, termenul si masurile compensatorii.
recommendation.en: Formalize residual-risk acceptance, including rationale, timeframe and compensating measures.

text.ro: Tratamentul riscurilor este urmarit prin planuri, owneri si termene clare?
text.en: Is risk treatment tracked through plans, owners and clear deadlines?

recommendation.ro: Gestionati planurile de tratament cu owneri, termene, KPI si escaladare pentru intarzieri.
recommendation.en: Manage treatment plans with owners, deadlines, KPIs and escalation for delays.

text.ro: Sunt evaluate anual riscurile emergente relevante pentru energie/gaze (ex. AI, supply chain, geopolitic)?
text.en: Are emerging risks relevant to energy/gas assessed annually (e.g. AI, supply chain, geopolitics)?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti un proces anual de horizon scanning pentru riscuri emergente si actualizati registrul de riscuri.
recommendation.en: Introduce an annual horizon-scanning process for emerging risks and update the risk register.

text.ro: Exista un inventar complet si actualizat al activelor IT critice?
text.en: Is there a complete and up-to-date inventory of critical IT assets?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti un inventar complet al activelor IT, actualizat automat sau periodic reconciliat.
recommendation.en: Maintain a complete IT asset inventory, updated automatically or periodically reconciled.

text.ro: Exista un inventar complet si actualizat al activelor OT/ICS/SCADA?
text.en: Is there a complete and up-to-date inventory of OT/ICS/SCADA assets?

recommendation.ro: Implementati descoperire pasiva OT si reconciliere periodica pentru toate activele OT/ICS/SCADA.
recommendation.en: Implement passive OT discovery and periodic reconciliation for all OT/ICS/SCADA assets.

text.ro: Activele sunt clasificate dupa criticitate, locatie si rol in serviciile esentiale?
text.en: Are assets classified by criticality, location and role in essential services?

recommendation.ro: Clasificati activele dupa criticitate, sensibilitate, locatie si rol operational.
recommendation.en: Classify assets by criticality, sensitivity, location and operational role.

text.ro: Exista mapping intre servicii esentiale, procese, aplicatii, retele si active?
text.en: Is there mapping between essential services, processes, applications, networks and assets?

recommendation.ro: Documentati service maps end-to-end pentru toate serviciile esentiale si actualizati-le dupa schimbari majore.
recommendation.en: Document end-to-end service maps for all essential services and update them after major changes.

text.ro: Sunt identificate si marcate activele cu single point of failure?
text.en: Are assets that are single points of failure identified and marked?

recommendation.ro: Identificati si etichetati activele SPOF si definiti masuri de redundanta sau compensare.
recommendation.en: Identify and tag SPOF assets and define redundancy or compensating measures.

text.ro: Exista evidenta software-ului autorizat, neautorizat si a componentelor open-source relevante?
text.en: Is there an inventory of authorized, unauthorized and relevant open-source software components?

recommendation.ro: Implementati control al software-ului autorizat si mentineti evidenta componentelor si dependintelor relevante.
recommendation.en: Implement authorized-software control and maintain an inventory of relevant components and dependencies.

text.ro: Exista o evidenta a interfetelor dintre IT, OT, telecom si cloud?
text.en: Is there an inventory of interfaces between IT, OT, telecom and cloud?

recommendation.ro: Documentati toate interfetele si fluxurile dintre domenii si validati periodic necesitatea lor.
recommendation.en: Document all interfaces and flows between domains and validate their necessity periodically.

text.ro: Exista proceduri de decommissioning securizat pentru echipamente si medii de stocare?
text.en: Are there secure decommissioning procedures for equipment and storage media?

recommendation.ro: Definiti proceduri de stergere, distrugere si retragere controlata pentru active si medii de stocare.
recommendation.en: Define wipe, destruction and controlled-retirement procedures for assets and storage media.

text.ro: Exista inventar si clasificare pentru active mobile, portabile si dispozitive de teren?
text.en: Is there an inventory and classification for mobile, portable and field devices?

recommendation.ro: Inventariati dispozitivele de teren si aplicati controale pentru criptare, patching si acces.
recommendation.en: Inventory field devices and apply controls for encryption, patching and access.

text.ro: Exista dovada de reconciliere periodica intre inventare, configuratii si realitatea din teren?
text.en: Is there evidence of periodic reconciliation between inventories, configurations and field reality?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti reconciliere periodica intre inventar, configuratii si verificarile fizice din teren.
recommendation.en: Introduce periodic reconciliation between inventory, configurations and physical field checks.

text.ro: Exista segregare stricta intre mediile IT si OT conform unei arhitecturi de tip zones and conduits?
text.en: Is there strict segregation between IT and OT environments using a zones-and-conduits architecture?

recommendation.ro: Implementati segmentare clara IT/OT, zone de securitate si fluxuri controlate intre ele.
recommendation.en: Implement clear IT/OT segmentation, security zones and controlled flows between them.

text.ro: Traficul OT este monitorizat continuu prin tehnologii dedicate de detectie?
text.en: Is OT traffic continuously monitored through dedicated detection technologies?

recommendation.ro: Implementati monitorizare pasiva si detectie de anomalii pentru retelele si protocoalele OT.
recommendation.en: Implement passive monitoring and anomaly detection for OT networks and protocols.

text.ro: Accesul remote la OT este permis doar prin jump hosts, MFA si inregistrarea sesiunilor?
text.en: Is remote OT access allowed only through jump hosts, MFA and session recording?

recommendation.ro: Interziceti accesul direct si folositi jump hosts, MFA, aprobari si inregistrare de sesiuni.
recommendation.en: Prohibit direct access and use jump hosts, MFA, approvals and session recording.

text.ro: Exista un proces formal de patch si firmware management pentru OT, bazat pe risc si testare?
text.en: Is there a formal OT patch and firmware management process based on risk and testing?

recommendation.ro: Definiti un proces OT de patching bazat pe testare in staging, risc operational si ferestre aprobate.
recommendation.en: Define an OT patching process based on staging tests, operational risk and approved maintenance windows.

text.ro: Configuratiile PLC, HMI, RTU si serverelor SCADA sunt versionate si protejate?
text.en: Are PLC, HMI, RTU and SCADA server configurations versioned and protected?

recommendation.ro: Versionati configuratiile critice, controlati schimbarile si pastrati backup-uri offline testate.
recommendation.en: Version critical configurations, control changes and keep tested offline backups.

text.ro: Sunt separate conturile administrative OT de conturile IT si utilizator?
text.en: Are OT administrative accounts separated from IT and user accounts?

recommendation.ro: Separati conturile administrative OT, aplicati least privilege si monitorizati activitatea privilegiata.
recommendation.en: Separate OT administrative accounts, apply least privilege and monitor privileged activity.

text.ro: Exista whitelisting aplicativ sau controale compensatorii echivalente pe endpoint-urile OT?
text.en: Is application whitelisting or equivalent compensating control used on OT endpoints?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati whitelisting sau controale compensatorii pe HMI-uri si alte endpoint-uri OT compatibile.
recommendation.en: Apply whitelisting or compensating controls on compatible HMIs and other OT endpoints.

text.ro: Exista o evaluare periodica a integritatii firmware-ului si a configuratiilor critice OT?
text.en: Is there a periodic assessment of firmware and critical OT configuration integrity?

recommendation.ro: Verificati periodic integritatea firmware-ului si configuratiilor si remediati abaterile detectate.
recommendation.en: Periodically verify firmware and configuration integrity and remediate detected deviations.

text.ro: Exista controale stricte pentru medii amovibile si dispozitive externe in OT?
text.en: Are strict controls in place for removable media and external devices in OT?

recommendation.ro: Blocati sau controlati strict mediile amovibile, scanati-le si logati utilizarea lor in OT.
recommendation.en: Block or tightly control removable media, scan them and log their use in OT.

text.ro: Exista teste periodice ale controalelor OT, inclusiv failover, restaurare si scenarii de izolare?
text.en: Are OT controls periodically tested, including failover, restoration and isolation scenarios?

recommendation.ro: Testati periodic failover-ul, restaurarea si izolarea segmentelor OT in scenarii controlate.
recommendation.en: Periodically test failover, restoration and OT-segment isolation in controlled scenarios.

text.ro: Exista un proces formal de management al vulnerabilitatilor pentru IT si OT?
text.en: Is there a formal vulnerability management process for IT and OT?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal de identificare, prioritizare, remediere si exceptare a vulnerabilitatilor.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal process for identifying, prioritizing, remediating and accepting vulnerabilities.

text.ro: Sunt monitorizate advisories de la furnizori, CERT-uri si autoritati relevante pentru produsele utilizate?
text.en: Are advisories from vendors, CERTs and relevant authorities monitored for used products?

recommendation.ro: Subscrieti-va la advisories relevante si operationalizati trierea impactului asupra mediului propriu.
recommendation.en: Subscribe to relevant advisories and operationalize impact triage for your environment.

text.ro: Exista SLA-uri de remediere diferite pentru vulnerabilitati critice, ridicate si medii?
text.en: Are there different remediation SLAs for critical, high and medium vulnerabilities?

recommendation.ro: Definiti SLA-uri de remediere in functie de severitate, expunere si criticitatea serviciilor.
recommendation.en: Define remediation SLAs based on severity, exposure and service criticality.

text.ro: Exista un proces formal pentru exceptii de patching la sistemele OT care nu pot fi actualizate rapid?
text.en: Is there a formal process for patching exceptions on OT systems that cannot be updated quickly?

recommendation.ro: Documentati exceptiile de patching OT si aplicati controale compensatorii, owneri si termene de revizuire.
recommendation.en: Document OT patching exceptions and apply compensating controls, owners and review dates.

text.ro: Scanarile de vulnerabilitati sunt adaptate astfel incat sa nu afecteze disponibilitatea mediului OT?
text.en: Are vulnerability scans adapted so they do not affect OT availability?

recommendation.ro: Folositi metode sigure pentru OT, validati impactul si evitati scanarile intruzive neaprobate.
recommendation.en: Use OT-safe methods, validate impact and avoid unauthorized intrusive scans.

text.ro: Schimbarile majore IT/OT sunt aprobate printr-un proces CAB cu participarea securitatii?
text.en: Are major IT/OT changes approved through a CAB process with security participation?

recommendation.ro: Integrați securitatea in CAB si impuneti evaluare de risc si plan de rollback pentru schimbari majore.
recommendation.en: Integrate security into the CAB and require risk assessment and rollback plans for major changes.

text.ro: Exista medii de staging / test pentru schimbari critice in OT?
text.en: Are there staging/test environments for critical OT changes?

recommendation.ro: Folositi medii de test reprezentative pentru schimbarile critice si documentati rezultatele testelor.
recommendation.en: Use representative test environments for critical changes and document test outcomes.

text.ro: Exista dovada de revalidare a controalelor de securitate dupa schimbari semnificative?
text.en: Is there evidence of revalidation of security controls after significant changes?

recommendation.ro: Definiti verificari post-change pentru autentificare, segmentare, logging si acces privilegiat.
recommendation.en: Define post-change checks for authentication, segmentation, logging and privileged access.

text.ro: Exista un proces de vulnerability disclosure sau intake pentru raportari externe relevante?
text.en: Is there a vulnerability disclosure or intake process for relevant external reports?

recommendation.ro: Stabiliti un canal formal de intake pentru vulnerabilitati raportate extern si criterii de tratament.
recommendation.en: Establish a formal intake channel for externally reported vulnerabilities and treatment criteria.

text.ro: Exista corelare intre vulnerabilitati, active critice si servicii esentiale in prioritizarea remedierii?
text.en: Is there correlation between vulnerabilities, critical assets and essential services in remediation prioritization?

recommendation.ro: Prioritizati remedierea folosind criticitatea activului si impactul asupra serviciului esential, nu doar CVSS.
recommendation.en: Prioritize remediation using asset criticality and essential-service impact, not just CVSS.

text.ro: Toate sistemele critice trimit log-uri catre o platforma centrala de monitorizare?
text.en: Do all critical systems send logs to a central monitoring platform?

recommendation.ro: Centralizati log-urile sistemelor critice intr-o platforma SIEM sau echivalenta si validati acoperirea.
recommendation.en: Centralize logs from critical systems into a SIEM or equivalent platform and validate coverage.

text.ro: Exista use case-uri de detectie pentru atacuri relevante sectorului energie/gaze?
text.en: Are there detection use cases for threats relevant to the energy/gas sector?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si mentineti use case-uri de detectie pentru ransomware, acces neautorizat, sabotaj si manipulare OT.
recommendation.en: Define and maintain detection use cases for ransomware, unauthorized access, sabotage and OT manipulation.

text.ro: Sunt monitorizate autentificarile, accesul privilegiat si sesiunile remote critice?
text.en: Are authentications, privileged access and critical remote sessions monitored?

recommendation.ro: Monitorizati central autentificarile, sesiunile remote si activitatea privilegiata si generati alerte relevante.
recommendation.en: Centrally monitor authentications, remote sessions and privileged activity and generate relevant alerts.

text.ro: Exista integrare intre alertele IT, OT, fizice si telecom pentru corelare de incidente?
text.en: Is there integration between IT, OT, physical and telecom alerts for incident correlation?

recommendation.ro: Integrati surse de date relevante pentru corelare cross-domain si prioritizare corecta a incidentelor.
recommendation.en: Integrate relevant data sources for cross-domain correlation and correct incident prioritization.

text.ro: Exista monitorizare a integritatii log-urilor si protectie impotriva modificarii lor?
text.en: Is there monitoring of log integrity and protection against tampering?

recommendation.ro: Protejati log-urile impotriva modificarii si implementati controale de integritate si retentie.
recommendation.en: Protect logs against tampering and implement integrity and retention controls.

text.ro: Sunt definite praguri si proceduri de escaladare pentru alertele cu impact asupra serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Are thresholds and escalation procedures defined for alerts impacting essential services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti praguri clare de alertare si escaladare pe baza impactului asupra serviciilor esentiale.
recommendation.en: Define clear alerting and escalation thresholds based on impact to essential services.

text.ro: Exista o functie 24/7 sau on-call pentru monitorizarea evenimentelor critice?
text.en: Is there a 24/7 or on-call function for monitoring critical events?

recommendation.ro: Asigurati acoperire 24/7 sau on-call pentru evenimentele critice cu potential impact operational.
recommendation.en: Ensure 24/7 or on-call coverage for critical events with potential operational impact.

text.ro: Se masoara periodic acoperirea surselor de log si eficienta detectiei?
text.en: Is log-source coverage and detection effectiveness measured periodically?

recommendation.ro: Masurati periodic acoperirea log-urilor, calitatea datelor si performanta detectiei si remediati gap-urile.
recommendation.en: Periodically measure log coverage, data quality and detection performance and remediate gaps.

text.ro: Exista monitorizare a conexiunilor externe si a fluxurilor catre/dinspre mediile critice?
text.en: Is there monitoring of external connections and flows to/from critical environments?

recommendation.ro: Monitorizati si revizuiti conexiunile externe si fluxurile dintre mediile critice si periferie.
recommendation.en: Monitor and review external connections and flows between critical environments and the perimeter.

text.ro: Exista proceduri de tuning si reducere a alertelor false pentru a mentine eficienta operationala?
text.en: Are there procedures for tuning and reducing false positives to maintain operational efficiency?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti un proces de tuning periodic pentru reguli si alerte, bazat pe feedback operational.
recommendation.en: Introduce a periodic tuning process for rules and alerts based on operational feedback.

text.ro: Exista un plan de raspuns la incidente documentat, aprobat si testat periodic?
text.en: Is there a documented, approved and periodically tested incident response plan?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si testati periodic un plan de raspuns la incidente care acopera IT, OT, comunicare si evidenta.
recommendation.en: Define and periodically test an incident response plan covering IT, OT, communications and evidence.

text.ro: Exista playbook-uri specifice pentru ransomware, compromitere cont privilegiat, afectare OT si indisponibilitate SCADA?
text.en: Are specific playbooks available for ransomware, privileged-account compromise, OT impact and SCADA unavailability?

recommendation.ro: Creati playbook-uri pentru scenariile majore relevante si exercitati-le regulat.
recommendation.en: Create playbooks for major relevant scenarios and exercise them regularly.

text.ro: Exista proceduri documentate pentru notificarea incidentelor catre CSIRT si autoritati sectoriale?
text.en: Are there documented procedures for incident notification to the CSIRT and sectoral authorities?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati fluxul de notificare, sabloanele, criteriile si rolurile pentru notificari NIS2.
recommendation.en: Formalize the notification flow, templates, criteria and roles for NIS2 notifications.

text.ro: Exista criterii de clasificare si prioritate a incidentelor care includ impactul asupra serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Are incident classification and priority criteria in place including impact on essential services?

recommendation.ro: Actualizati schema de clasificare a incidentelor pentru a include impactul asupra serviciilor esentiale si sigurantei.
recommendation.en: Update incident classification to include impact on essential services and safety.

text.ro: Exista capacitate de colectare si conservare a dovezilor inclusiv pentru sisteme OT?
text.en: Is there capability to collect and preserve evidence, including for OT systems?

recommendation.ro: Definiti proceduri si capabilitati de evidence handling si digital forensics pentru IT si OT.
recommendation.en: Define evidence-handling procedures and digital-forensics capabilities for IT and OT.

text.ro: Exista exercitii periodice tabletop si/sau live pentru scenarii cyber care afecteaza furnizarea energiei/gazelor?
text.en: Are there periodic tabletop and/or live exercises for cyber scenarios affecting electricity/gas delivery?

recommendation.ro: Planificati exercitii regulate pentru scenarii cu impact operational, de continuitate si raportare.
recommendation.en: Plan regular exercises for scenarios with operational, continuity and reporting impact.

text.ro: Se realizeaza lessons learned si actualizarea controalelor dupa incidente si exercitii?
text.en: Are lessons learned performed and controls updated after incidents and exercises?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati post-mortem-ul si actualizati controalele, playbook-urile si planurile de continuitate.
recommendation.en: Formalize post-mortems and update controls, playbooks and continuity plans.

text.ro: Exista un plan de comunicare de criza pentru management, clienti, parteneri si autoritati?
text.en: Is there a crisis communications plan for management, customers, partners and authorities?

recommendation.ro: Definiti un plan de comunicare de criza cu mesaje preaprobate, canale alternative si purtatori de cuvant.
recommendation.en: Define a crisis communications plan with pre-approved messages, alternate channels and spokespeople.

text.ro: Exista acoperire on-call pentru incidente majore in afara orelor de program?
text.en: Is on-call coverage available for major incidents outside business hours?

recommendation.ro: Asigurati acoperire on-call pentru incidente majore si criterii clare de activare a echipei.
recommendation.en: Ensure on-call coverage for major incidents and clear criteria for team activation.

text.ro: Exista integrare intre raspunsul la incidente cyber si planurile de criza operationala / securitate fizica?
text.en: Is there integration between cyber incident response and operational-crisis / physical-security plans?

recommendation.ro: Aliniati planurile cyber cu cele de criza operationala, continuitate si securitate fizica.
recommendation.en: Align cyber plans with operational crisis, continuity and physical security plans.

text.ro: Exista planuri documentate de continuitate si recuperare pentru toate serviciile esentiale?
text.en: Are documented continuity and recovery plans in place for all essential services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti planuri BCP/DR pentru toate serviciile esentiale si actualizati-le periodic.
recommendation.en: Define BCP/DR plans for all essential services and update them periodically.

text.ro: Sunt definite RTO/RPO pentru procesele si sistemele care sustin serviciile esentiale?
text.en: Are RTO/RPO targets defined for processes and systems supporting essential services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti RTO/RPO bazate pe impact si validati-le cu managementul si operatiunile.
recommendation.en: Define RTO/RPO based on impact and validate them with management and operations.

text.ro: Backup-urile pentru sisteme si configuratii critice sunt protejate, offline/immutable si testate?
text.en: Are backups for critical systems and configurations protected, offline/immutable and tested?

recommendation.ro: Asigurati backup-uri offline/immutable pentru activele critice si testati periodic restaurarea.
recommendation.en: Ensure offline/immutable backups for critical assets and periodically test restoration.

text.ro: Exista redundanta pentru componentele critice si eliminarea punctelor unice de esec?
text.en: Is redundancy in place for critical components and are single points of failure addressed?

recommendation.ro: Implementati redundanta si planuri de compensare pentru componentele critice si SPOF-uri.
recommendation.en: Implement redundancy and compensating plans for critical components and SPOFs.

text.ro: Planurile de continuitate includ dependentele fata de furnizori si servicii externe critice?
text.en: Do continuity plans include dependencies on critical suppliers and external services?

recommendation.ro: Includeti dependentele de furnizori si servicii externe in BCP/DR si definiti optiuni de fallback.
recommendation.en: Include supplier and external-service dependencies in BCP/DR and define fallback options.

text.ro: Exista exercitii periodice de continuitate si recuperare, inclusiv scenarii cyber?
text.en: Are there periodic continuity and recovery exercises, including cyber scenarios?

recommendation.ro: Exersati periodic scenarii de indisponibilitate, restaurare, failover si pierdere a vizibilitatii OT.
recommendation.en: Regularly exercise unavailability, restoration, failover and OT-visibility-loss scenarios.

text.ro: Exista canale alternative de comunicare pentru situatii de criza si intreruperi majore?
text.en: Are alternate communications channels available for crisis situations and major outages?

recommendation.ro: Asigurati canale alternative si proceduri offline pentru coordonare in criza.
recommendation.en: Provide alternate channels and offline procedures for crisis coordination.

text.ro: Exista scenarii documentate pentru pierderea partiala a telecomunicatiilor si a accesului remote critic?
text.en: Are scenarios documented for partial telecom loss and critical remote-access outage?

recommendation.ro: Definiti scenarii si proceduri pentru degradarea telecom si indisponibilitatea accesului remote critic.
recommendation.en: Define scenarios and procedures for telecom degradation and critical remote-access outage.

text.ro: Exista proceduri de restaurare prioritizata in functie de impactul asupra serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Are there prioritized restoration procedures based on impact to essential services?

recommendation.ro: Prioritizati restaurarea proceselor si sistemelor pe baza impactului operational si social.
recommendation.en: Prioritize restoration of processes and systems based on operational and societal impact.

text.ro: Exista integrare intre BCP/DR, raspuns la incidente si managementul crizei?
text.en: Is there integration between BCP/DR, incident response and crisis management?

recommendation.ro: Aliniati BCP/DR, IR si crisis management intr-un cadru coerent de rezilienta.
recommendation.en: Align BCP/DR, IR and crisis management into a coherent resilience framework.

name.ro: Lant de aprovizionare si risc terti

text.ro: Exista inventar si clasificare a furnizorilor critici, inclusiv cei cu acces la IT/OT?
text.en: Is there an inventory and classification of critical suppliers, including those with IT/OT access?

recommendation.ro: Inventariati si clasificati furnizorii pe baza criticitatii, accesului si impactului asupra serviciilor esentiale.
recommendation.en: Inventory and classify suppliers based on criticality, access and impact to essential services.

text.ro: Contractele critice includ clauze de securitate, notificare incident, audit si continuitate?
text.en: Do critical contracts include security, incident-notification, audit and continuity clauses?

recommendation.ro: Actualizati sabloanele contractuale pentru a include clauze minime de securitate si notificare.
recommendation.en: Update contract templates to include minimum security and notification clauses.

text.ro: Exista due diligence de securitate inainte de onboarding pentru furnizorii critici?
text.en: Is security due diligence performed before onboarding critical suppliers?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti due diligence de securitate inainte de onboarding si cerinte minime pentru acceptare.
recommendation.en: Introduce security due diligence before onboarding and minimum requirements for acceptance.

text.ro: Accesul furnizorilor la sisteme critice este limitat, aprobat si monitorizat?
text.en: Is supplier access to critical systems limited, approved and monitored?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati least privilege, aprobari temporare, MFA si monitorizare pentru accesul furnizorilor.
recommendation.en: Apply least privilege, time-bound approvals, MFA and monitoring for supplier access.

text.ro: Exista reevaluare periodica a furnizorilor critici pe baza riscului?
text.en: Are critical suppliers periodically reassessed based on risk?

recommendation.ro: Stabiliti reevaluari periodice bazate pe risc si urmati remedierea gap-urilor identificate.
recommendation.en: Establish periodic risk-based reassessments and track remediation of identified gaps.

text.ro: Exista evaluare a subcontractorilor / fourth parties pentru furnizorii critici?
text.en: Are subcontractors / fourth parties assessed for critical suppliers?

recommendation.ro: Extindeti evaluarea la subcontractorii care pot influenta confidentialitatea, integritatea sau disponibilitatea.
recommendation.en: Extend assessment to subcontractors that may affect confidentiality, integrity or availability.

text.ro: Exista monitorizare continua a riscurilor furnizorilor critici (vulnerabilitati, incidente, reputatie)?
text.en: Is there continuous monitoring of critical-supplier risks (vulnerabilities, incidents, reputation)?

recommendation.ro: Implementati monitorizare continua pentru furnizorii critici si integrati semnalele in TPRM.
recommendation.en: Implement continuous monitoring for critical suppliers and integrate signals into TPRM.

text.ro: Exista planuri de contingenta pentru pierderea sau indisponibilitatea furnizorilor critici?
text.en: Are there contingency plans for loss or unavailability of critical suppliers?

recommendation.ro: Definiti planuri de fallback, alternative si proceduri de contingenta pentru furnizorii critici.
recommendation.en: Define fallback plans, alternatives and contingency procedures for critical suppliers.

text.ro: Exista cerinte privind SBOM, secure updates sau provenienta pentru produse critice OT/IT?
text.en: Are there requirements for SBOMs, secure updates or provenance for critical OT/IT products?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti cerinte pentru SBOM, secure updates si trasabilitatea produselor critice acolo unde este proportional.
recommendation.en: Introduce requirements for SBOMs, secure updates and provenance for critical products where proportionate.

text.ro: Exista un proces de offboarding pentru furnizori care elimina accesul si recupereaza activele/informatiile?
text.en: Is there an offboarding process for suppliers that removes access and recovers assets/information?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati offboarding-ul furnizorilor, revocarea accesului si recuperarea activelor si informatiilor.
recommendation.en: Formalize supplier offboarding, access revocation and recovery of assets and information.

text.ro: Exista controale de acces fizic pentru locatiile critice, dispecerate, statii si camere tehnice?
text.en: Are physical access controls in place for critical sites, control centers, substations and technical rooms?

recommendation.ro: Implementati controale de acces fizic proportionate pentru toate locatiile critice.
recommendation.en: Implement proportionate physical-access controls for all critical sites.

text.ro: Vizitatorii si contractorii sunt inregistrati, insotiti si monitorizati in zonele critice?
text.en: Are visitors and contractors logged, escorted and monitored in critical areas?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati proceduri stricte de acces pentru vizitatori si contractori in zonele critice.
recommendation.en: Apply strict access procedures for visitors and contractors in critical areas.

text.ro: Exista CCTV, detectie intruziune si alarme pentru locatiile si activele critice?
text.en: Are CCTV, intrusion detection and alarms in place for critical sites and assets?

recommendation.ro: Implementati monitorizare fizica si alarme pentru activele si zonele critice.
recommendation.en: Implement physical monitoring and alarms for critical assets and areas.

text.ro: Exista proceduri pentru protectia activa a cabinetelor, rackurilor si echipamentelor de teren?
text.en: Are procedures in place for protecting cabinets, racks and field equipment?

recommendation.ro: Protejati fizic echipamentele de teren si cabinetelor critice si verificati integritatea lor.
recommendation.en: Physically protect field equipment and critical cabinets and verify their integrity.

text.ro: Exista protectie la incendiu, inundatie, temperatura si alimentare electrica pentru sistemele critice?
text.en: Is there fire, flood, temperature and power protection for critical systems?

recommendation.ro: Implementati controale de mediu si alimentare pentru toate sistemele critice.
recommendation.en: Implement environmental and power controls for all critical systems.

text.ro: Exista integrare intre evenimentele fizice si monitorizarea cyber pentru detectarea sabotajului?
text.en: Is there integration between physical events and cyber monitoring for sabotage detection?

recommendation.ro: Corelati alarmele fizice cu monitorizarea cyber pentru a detecta mai rapid sabotajul si accesul neautorizat.
recommendation.en: Correlate physical alarms with cyber monitoring to detect sabotage and unauthorized access faster.

text.ro: Exista proceduri pentru controlul cheilor fizice, badge-urilor si al altor credentiale de acces?
text.en: Are there procedures for controlling physical keys, badges and other access credentials?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal pentru emitere, revocare, inventariere si audit al credentialelor fizice.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal process for issuance, revocation, inventory and audit of physical credentials.

text.ro: Exista planuri pentru incidente fizice care pot genera impact cyber sau operational?
text.en: Are there plans for physical incidents that may cause cyber or operational impact?

recommendation.ro: Aliniati planurile de securitate fizica cu raspunsul la incidente si continuitatea serviciilor.
recommendation.en: Align physical-security plans with incident response and service continuity.

text.ro: Exista verificari periodice ale starii fizice a echipamentelor din locatii izolate?
text.en: Are there periodic checks of the physical condition of equipment at remote sites?

recommendation.ro: Planificati inspectii periodice si verificari ale tamper-ului pentru locatiile izolate.
recommendation.en: Plan periodic inspections and tamper checks for remote sites.

text.ro: Exista criterii de prioritizare a masurilor fizice pentru activele care sustin servicii esentiale?
text.en: Are there criteria to prioritize physical protections for assets supporting essential services?

recommendation.ro: Prioritizati masurile fizice pentru activele cu cel mai mare impact asupra continuitatii serviciilor esentiale.
recommendation.en: Prioritize physical protections for assets with the highest impact on essential-service continuity.

text.ro: Cerintele de securitate sunt incluse in specificatiile de achizitie pentru sisteme IT/OT critice?
text.en: Are security requirements included in procurement specifications for critical IT/OT systems?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti cerinte minime de securitate in documentatia de achizitie pentru sisteme critice.
recommendation.en: Introduce minimum security requirements in procurement documentation for critical systems.

text.ro: Exista validare de securitate inainte de acceptanta operationala a noilor sisteme sau schimbari majore?
text.en: Is security validation performed before operational acceptance of new systems or major changes?

recommendation.ro: Impuneti criterii de acceptanta de securitate inainte de go-live pentru sisteme si schimbari critice.
recommendation.en: Enforce security acceptance criteria before go-live for critical systems and changes.

text.ro: Exista secure SDLC pentru dezvoltarea aplicatiilor interne sau custom?
text.en: Is a secure SDLC in place for internal or custom application development?

recommendation.ro: Implementati secure SDLC cu threat modeling, code review si testare de securitate.
recommendation.en: Implement a secure SDLC with threat modeling, code review and security testing.

text.ro: Exista controale pentru gestionarea credentiatelor, cheilor si secretelor in dezvoltare si operare?
text.en: Are controls in place for managing credentials, keys and secrets in development and operations?

recommendation.ro: Gestionati credentiatele si secretele prin vault-uri dedicate si eliminati hardcodarea lor.
recommendation.en: Manage credentials and secrets through dedicated vaults and eliminate hardcoding.

text.ro: Mentenanta efectuata de terti respecta proceduri de aprobare, acces minim si evidentiere a activitatilor?
text.en: Does third-party maintenance follow approval, least-access and activity-logging procedures?

recommendation.ro: Impuneti controale stricte pentru mentenanta externa, inclusiv aprobari, MFA si logging.
recommendation.en: Enforce strict controls for external maintenance, including approvals, MFA and logging.

text.ro: Exista baseline-uri de configurare securizata pentru noile sisteme si echipamente?
text.en: Are secure configuration baselines defined for new systems and equipment?

recommendation.ro: Definiti baseline-uri de hardening pentru sisteme noi si validati aplicarea lor.
recommendation.en: Define hardening baselines for new systems and validate their implementation.

text.ro: Exista un proces de gestionare a end-of-life / end-of-support pentru produse si platforme critice?
text.en: Is there a process for handling end-of-life / end-of-support for critical products and platforms?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti evidenta EOL/EOS si implementati planuri de inlocuire sau controale compensatorii.
recommendation.en: Maintain EOL/EOS inventory and implement replacement plans or compensating controls.

text.ro: Exista documentatie tehnica actualizata pentru arhitectura, interdependente si configuratii relevante?
text.en: Is updated technical documentation available for architecture, interdependencies and relevant configurations?

recommendation.ro: Mentineti documentatie tehnica actualizata pentru sisteme critice si schimbari majore.
recommendation.en: Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for critical systems and major changes.

text.ro: Exista testare de securitate a integrarii intre sisteme noi si mediul existent?
text.en: Is security testing performed for integration between new systems and the existing environment?

recommendation.ro: Testati securitatea integrarii, fluxurile de date si dependintele inainte de lansare.
recommendation.en: Test integration security, data flows and dependencies before release.

text.ro: Exista un audit trail complet pentru schimbari de configuratie, cod sau parametri operationali critici?
text.en: Is there a complete audit trail for changes to configuration, code or critical operational parameters?

recommendation.ro: Asigurati audit trail complet pentru schimbari critice si revizuire periodica a acestuia.
recommendation.en: Ensure a complete audit trail for critical changes and periodically review it.

text.ro: MFA este obligatoriu pentru accesul critic, inclusiv accesul remote la sisteme sensibile?
text.en: Is MFA mandatory for critical access, including remote access to sensitive systems?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati MFA fara exceptii pentru accesul critic, conturile privilegiate si accesul remote.
recommendation.en: Enforce MFA without exceptions for critical access, privileged accounts and remote access.

text.ro: Exista segmentare de retea adecvata pentru sistemele critice si mediile administrative?
text.en: Is adequate network segmentation in place for critical systems and administrative environments?

recommendation.ro: Segmentati mediile critice, administrative si de utilizatori si controlati fluxurile dintre ele.
recommendation.en: Segment critical, administrative and user environments and control flows between them.

text.ro: Log-urile IT, OT si cloud sunt colectate central si pastrate conform politicii?
text.en: Are IT, OT and cloud logs centrally collected and retained per policy?

recommendation.ro: Colectati si pastrati log-urile relevante conform unei politici aprobate si verificati acoperirea.
recommendation.en: Collect and retain relevant logs per an approved policy and verify coverage.

text.ro: Datele sensibile si comunicatiile critice sunt protejate prin criptare sau controale echivalente?
text.en: Are sensitive data and critical communications protected through encryption or equivalent controls?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati criptare pentru date sensibile si fluxuri critice, acolo unde este adecvat tehnic si operational.
recommendation.en: Apply encryption for sensitive data and critical flows where technically and operationally appropriate.

text.ro: Exista EDR/XDR sau controale echivalente pe endpoint-urile si serverele compatibile?
text.en: Is EDR/XDR or equivalent control deployed on compatible endpoints and servers?

recommendation.ro: Implementati EDR/XDR pe sistemele compatibile si completati cu controale compensatorii unde nu este posibil.
recommendation.en: Deploy EDR/XDR on compatible systems and complement with compensating controls where not possible.

text.ro: Exista control strict al accesului privilegiat si revizuire periodica a acestuia?
text.en: Is privileged access tightly controlled and periodically reviewed?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati least privilege, segregarea rolurilor si revizuiri periodice pentru accesul privilegiat.
recommendation.en: Apply least privilege, role segregation and periodic reviews for privileged access.

text.ro: Exista protectie impotriva malware, executie neautorizata si scripturi periculoase?
text.en: Is protection in place against malware, unauthorized execution and dangerous scripts?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati protectie antimalware, whitelisting si politici de executie controlata unde este posibil.
recommendation.en: Apply anti-malware protection, whitelisting and controlled execution policies where possible.

text.ro: Exista hardening de baza pentru sisteme, echipamente de retea si servicii expuse?
text.en: Is baseline hardening in place for systems, network devices and exposed services?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati baseline-uri de hardening si revizuiti periodic configuratiile pentru sisteme si servicii critice.
recommendation.en: Apply hardening baselines and periodically review configurations for critical systems and services.

text.ro: Exista control al dispozitivelor mobile, portabile si al accesului wireless relevant operational?
text.en: Are mobile, portable and relevant wireless accesses controlled?

recommendation.ro: Controlati dispozitivele mobile si portabile, criptati-le si limitati accesul wireless nejustificat.
recommendation.en: Control mobile and portable devices, encrypt them and limit unjustified wireless access.

text.ro: Exista protectie pentru email si canale de colaborare impotriva phishingului si compromiterii conturilor?
text.en: Is protection in place for email and collaboration channels against phishing and account compromise?

recommendation.ro: Implementati filtre de email, DMARC/SPF/DKIM si politici pentru colaborare securizata.
recommendation.en: Implement email filtering, DMARC/SPF/DKIM and policies for secure collaboration.

text.ro: Exista autentificare centralizata si controlata pentru utilizatori, administratori si aplicatii critice?
text.en: Is there centralized and controlled authentication for users, administrators and critical applications?

recommendation.ro: Centralizati autentificarea pentru utilizatori, admini si aplicatii unde este adecvat.
recommendation.en: Centralize authentication for users, admins and applications where appropriate.

text.ro: Exista politici pentru parole/passphrases si protectie impotriva brute force / credential stuffing?
text.en: Are there password/passphrase policies and protections against brute force / credential stuffing?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati politici moderne pentru parole/passphrases si protectii impotriva atacurilor de autentificare.
recommendation.en: Apply modern password/passphrase policies and protections against authentication attacks.

text.ro: Exista PAM/PIM sau controale echivalente pentru conturile privilegiate?
text.en: Is PAM/PIM or an equivalent control in place for privileged accounts?

recommendation.ro: Implementati PAM/PIM sau controale echivalente pentru administratori si accesul privilegiat temporar.
recommendation.en: Implement PAM/PIM or equivalent controls for administrators and time-bound privileged access.

text.ro: Exista protectie si monitorizare pentru canale de comunicare de criza si coordonare?
text.en: Are crisis and coordination communication channels protected and monitored?

recommendation.ro: Definiti canale de comunicare protejate pentru criza si verificati disponibilitatea lor.
recommendation.en: Define protected crisis-communication channels and verify their availability.

text.ro: Exista control al certificatelor, cheilor si ciclului lor de viata pentru sistemele relevante?
text.en: Is there control of certificates, keys and their lifecycle for relevant systems?

recommendation.ro: Implementati management al certificatelor si cheilor, cu inventar, expirare si rotatie.
recommendation.en: Implement certificate and key management with inventory, expiry tracking and rotation.

text.ro: Exista revizuire periodica a accesului utilizatorilor si furnizorilor la resurse critice?
text.en: Are user and supplier accesses to critical resources periodically reviewed?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti revizuiri periodice ale accesului pentru utilizatori, administratori si terti.
recommendation.en: Introduce periodic access reviews for users, administrators and third parties.

text.ro: Conturile inactive, orphaned sau partajate sunt identificate si tratate?
text.en: Are inactive, orphaned or shared accounts identified and addressed?

recommendation.ro: Eliminati conturile partajate unde este posibil si gestionati sistematic conturile inactive/orfane.
recommendation.en: Eliminate shared accounts where possible and systematically manage inactive/orphaned accounts.

text.ro: Exista protectie impotriva MFA fatigue si push bombing pentru fluxurile care folosesc push MFA?
text.en: Is there protection against MFA fatigue and push bombing for workflows using push MFA?

recommendation.ro: Activati number matching sau controale echivalente pentru a reduce riscul MFA fatigue.
recommendation.en: Enable number matching or equivalent controls to reduce MFA-fatigue risk.

text.ro: Exista autentificare puternica pentru VPN si accesul remote operational critic?
text.en: Is strong authentication enforced for VPN and critical remote operational access?

recommendation.ro: Aplicati autentificare puternica si politici de acces contextual pentru VPN si remote access critic.
recommendation.en: Apply strong authentication and context-aware access policies for VPN and critical remote access.

text.ro: Exista monitorizare a autentificarilor anormale si a accesului din locatii / momente neobisnuite?
text.en: Is anomalous authentication and access from unusual locations/times monitored?

recommendation.ro: Implementati monitorizare UEBA sau reguli echivalente pentru detectarea autentificarilor anormale.
recommendation.en: Implement UEBA or equivalent rules for detecting anomalous authentications.

text.ro: Tot personalul participa anual la training de securitate cibernetica?
text.en: Do all personnel complete annual cyber security training?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti training anual obligatoriu pentru tot personalul si monitorizati completarea.
recommendation.en: Introduce mandatory annual training for all personnel and monitor completion.

text.ro: Personalul OT primeste training specific privind securitatea ICS/SCADA si riscurile operationale?
text.en: Do OT personnel receive specific training on ICS/SCADA security and operational risks?

recommendation.ro: Definiti module dedicate pentru personalul OT privind ICS/SCADA, remote access si response procedures.
recommendation.en: Define dedicated modules for OT staff on ICS/SCADA, remote access and response procedures.

text.ro: Exista simulări periodice de phishing si social engineering?
text.en: Are there periodic phishing and social-engineering simulations?

recommendation.ro: Rulati campanii periodice de simulare si folositi rezultatele pentru imbunatatirea programului.
recommendation.en: Run periodic simulation campaigns and use the results to improve the program.

text.ro: Managementul si board-ul primesc training specific privind responsabilitatile lor NIS2?
text.en: Do management and the board receive specific training on their NIS2 responsibilities?

recommendation.ro: Organizati sesiuni dedicate pentru board si management pe obligatii si scenarii relevante.
recommendation.en: Organize dedicated sessions for the board and management on obligations and relevant scenarios.

text.ro: Exista proceduri prin care angajatii stiu cum sa raporteze rapid evenimentele suspecte?
text.en: Are procedures in place so employees know how to rapidly report suspicious events?

recommendation.ro: Comunicati canalul de raportare, criteriile de raportare si asteptarile de reactie initiala.
recommendation.en: Communicate the reporting channel, reporting criteria and expectations for initial response.

text.ro: Programul de awareness este adaptat pe roluri si expuneri diferite?
text.en: Is the awareness program tailored to different roles and exposures?

recommendation.ro: Segmentati continutul de awareness pentru IT, OT, management, teren si functii suport.
recommendation.en: Segment awareness content for IT, OT, management, field staff and support functions.

text.ro: Exista masurarea eficientei programului de awareness prin KPI sau rezultate de testare?
text.en: Is the effectiveness of the awareness program measured through KPIs or testing results?

recommendation.ro: Masurati eficienta programului prin rezultate la teste, phishing, raportare si feedback.
recommendation.en: Measure program effectiveness through test results, phishing outcomes, reporting and feedback.

text.ro: Exista training de onboarding si offboarding legat de securitate si acces?
text.en: Is there onboarding and offboarding training related to security and access?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti training de onboarding si proceduri clare de offboarding pentru personal si terti.
recommendation.en: Introduce onboarding training and clear offboarding procedures for staff and third parties.

text.ro: Exista materiale si comunicari periodice pentru igiena cibernetica de baza?
text.en: Are periodic materials and communications available for basic cyber hygiene?

recommendation.ro: Derulati comunicari periodice privind igiena cibernetica si bune practici operationale.
recommendation.en: Run periodic communications on cyber hygiene and operational good practices.

text.ro: Exista training dedicat contractorilor si furnizorilor cu acces in zone sau sisteme critice?
text.en: Is dedicated training provided to contractors and suppliers with access to critical areas or systems?

recommendation.ro: Definiti un pachet minim de training si instruire pentru tertii cu acces critic.
recommendation.en: Define a minimum training package and induction for third parties with critical access.

text.ro: Exista un proces periodic de evaluare a eficientei controalelor de securitate?
text.en: Is there a periodic process to assess the effectiveness of security controls?

recommendation.ro: Implementati evaluari periodice ale eficientei controalelor si raportati rezultatele managementului.
recommendation.en: Implement periodic control-effectiveness assessments and report the results to management.

text.ro: Se efectueaza testari tehnice periodice proportionate (scanari, exercitii, evaluari) pentru mediile relevante?
text.en: Are proportionate periodic technical tests performed (scans, exercises, assessments) for relevant environments?

recommendation.ro: Planificati testari tehnice proportionate pentru mediile relevante, inclusiv OT-safe unde este cazul.
recommendation.en: Plan proportionate technical testing for relevant environments, including OT-safe approaches where needed.

text.ro: Exista audit intern periodic al masurilor NIS2 si urmarire a remediilor?
text.en: Is there periodic internal audit of NIS2 measures and remediation tracking?

recommendation.ro: Derulati audit intern periodic pentru masurile NIS2 si urmariti in mod formal remedierea.
recommendation.en: Conduct periodic internal audits of NIS2 measures and formally track remediation.

text.ro: Se masoara timpul mediu de detectie, raspuns si recuperare pentru incidente semnificative?
text.en: Are mean time to detect, respond and recover measured for significant incidents?

recommendation.ro: Masurati si analizati MTTD, MTTR si MTTRestore pentru incidentele semnificative.
recommendation.en: Measure and analyze MTTD, MTTR and MTTRestore for significant incidents.

text.ro: Exista evaluare periodica a acoperirii detectiei si a gap-urilor majore de control?
text.en: Is there periodic assessment of detection coverage and major control gaps?

recommendation.ro: Efectuati periodic o evaluare a acoperirii controalelor si a gap-urilor critice.
recommendation.en: Periodically assess control coverage and critical gaps.

text.ro: Exista benchmark sau referential de maturitate folosit pentru evaluarea progresului?
text.en: Is a benchmark or maturity reference model used to assess progress?

recommendation.ro: Adoptati un model de maturitate si urmariti progresul anual pe domenii.
recommendation.en: Adopt a maturity model and track annual progress by domain.

text.ro: Se verifica periodic daca masurile implementate reduc riscul in practica, nu doar pe hartie?
text.en: Is it periodically verified that implemented measures reduce risk in practice, not just on paper?

recommendation.ro: Corelati controalele implementate cu riscurile si incidentele pentru a valida eficienta reala.
recommendation.en: Correlate implemented controls with risks and incidents to validate real effectiveness.

text.ro: Exista un proces de raportare a gap-urilor majore catre management si board?
text.en: Is there a process to report major gaps to management and the board?

recommendation.ro: Escaladati gap-urile majore catre management si board cu planuri si termene de remediere.
recommendation.en: Escalate major gaps to management and the board with remediation plans and deadlines.

text.ro: Exista validare periodica a furnizorilor si controalelor third-party cu impact asupra serviciilor esentiale?
text.en: Is there periodic validation of suppliers and third-party controls affecting essential services?

recommendation.ro: Validati periodic controalele third-party si impactul lor asupra serviciilor esentiale.
recommendation.en: Periodically validate third-party controls and their impact on essential services.

text.ro: Exista un mecanism de imbunatatire continua care transforma rezultatele auditului si exercitiilor in actiuni?
text.en: Is there a continuous-improvement mechanism that turns audit and exercise results into actions?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un mecanism formal de continuous improvement cu actiuni, owneri si termene.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal continuous-improvement mechanism with actions, owners and deadlines.
